facts.business: Trade Wings Limited is engaged in the business of travel and travel related services and also in the Cargo business.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is expected to earn more profits in the coming years.

auditor.name: M/s. GHV & Co., Practising Company Secretaries
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Secretarial Auditors' Report contains adverse remarks with regard to the non-compliance under various regulations of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and the Companies Act, 2013 and rule made thereunder: 1. Certain charges continue to be reflected as active on the MCA portal. However, based on the financial records and certificates representation made by the Company, the underlying loans have been duly repaid and the corresponding charges have been satisfied. The Company is in the process of reconciling the records relating to such old charges and updating the MCA records, as applicable. 2. The Company had received a notice dated 30 November 2022 from BSE Limited in relation to Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) fines arising from certain past instances of delayed submission of filings. The Company had submitted a request for waiver of the applicable fines and for revocation of suspension of trading. An amount of ₹15.69 lakh was paid by the Company under protest. Subsequently, BSE Limited considered the Company's request and waived the applicable fines. Further, the Internal Regulatory Oversight and Review Group of BSE Limited granted an in-principle approval for revocation of suspension vide its letter dated 26 May 2025.

key_risks: Our business will suffer if we fail to anticipate and provide new services and enhance existing services to keep pace with rapid changes in the businesses on which we focus.

In the event that the Government of India or the government of another country changes its external affairs policies in a manner that is averse to us, our revenues may be affected, reducing our profitability.

The Tours and Travel industry is a cyclical industry and is sensitive to changes in the economy in general. A slowdown in global economy in general and any of our focused economies in particular can unfavourably impact our business.
Negative changes in export outlook, expectations, estimates and others.
High taxes on hotels, airline facilities, and tour operators can cause losses to the company compared to cheaper countries.
